selection_rationale: Radial Engineering boxes (JDI, J48, ProDI/ProD2, JPC, JS2, ProMS2, JCR) form the core because they are the usual rider/backline DI and splitter references and every one has an official manual, a smart sheet and a web spec page, which allows a two-source cross-check. Countryman Type 85 (which its own datasheet calls 'an industry standard'), Klark Teknik DN100 V2 and Behringer DI100 cover active DIs at three price points; Palmer PAN 01 is the common European budget passive DI. Ebtech Hum Eliminator and Radial JCR cover line isolation and re-amping. Together they cover every TekPractice impedance/level lesson: instrument hi-Z -> mic level, consumer -10 dBV (RCA / 3.5 mm) -> mic level, mic split with phantom return path, line -> instrument (re-amp) and unbalanced <-> balanced isolation.
